summary:
Wi‑Fi is off. It was already off when I checked: in Settings under Network & internet, then Internet, the Wi‑Fi switch was in the off position, so I didn't need to change anything. The phone is using mobile data from T‑Mobile (3G) instead.

That screen also says "Wi‑Fi turns back on automatically," so the phone may switch Wi‑Fi back on by itself later. You can turn that off under Network preferences.
